title: Systematic extraction jobs
measuredOrigin: Measured coverage check; no model call
skip: Acknowledge uncertain charge and skip unit
skipHelp: This skips unresolved units without resending them. The provider accounting remains uncertain.
cancelHelp: Cancellation stops new batches and attempts to interrupt the active call. Tokens already processed may still be charged.
help: Enumerate every authorized study and selected field. Preparation sends no model request. Index documents first; missing or unreadable content stays visible in coverage.
noForm: Create an extraction form in the matrix first, then refresh jobs.
searchHelp: A search miss is NOT_FOUND_IN_SEARCH. Even a complete scan can only propose NOT_REPORTED_CANDIDATE for human review.
force: Require new execution instead of a cache hit
cacheCleared: Derived cache cleared; proposals and human decisions are preserved.
empty: No extraction jobs in this snapshot.
estimate: Estimated input tokens; this is not a verified billing bound
noBatch: No readable evidence selected. This unit makes no model call and reports only measured coverage.
proposal: Proposal saved for human review in the matrix
uncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Retry the same operation before making another change.
